name: Cuplock Scaffolding System
tagline: The Kingdom’s Proven Modular Access & Shoring Backbone
shortDescription: A modular steel scaffolding system using cup-type locking connections between standards and ledgers, fabricated in Riyadh according to SASO standards.
description: A heavy-duty, fast-erecting multi-point node scaffolding system manufactured from high-yield structural steel tubes.
systemInformation: Standards incorporate fixed bottom cups welded at 500mm intervals. Loose top cups slide down and rotate over ledger blade ends, locking up to four horizontal components with a single hammer blow.
applicationDescription: Temporary access, safe working platforms, facade maintenance, and medium-to-heavy structural falsework support during concrete casting.
benefits: Rapid hammer-strike node locking without loose bolts
High yield S355 steel with hot-dip galvanizing
Zero maintenance wear nodes tested to SASO 2874
High local inventory available for 24-hr site delivery

name: Manhole Formwork Systems
tagline: Engineered Reusable Steel Moulds for Underground Infrastructure
shortDescription: A reusable forming and construction solution manufactured in KSA for pouring square, rectangular, and round concrete manhole structures.
description: Rigid external steel shuttering panels paired with a proprietary collapsible internal core mechanism for high-frequency municipal utility casting.
systemInformation: Inner core contracts inward via corner toggle hinges or central turnbuckles once concrete reaches initial set, allowing the assembly to be stripped and craned in minutes.
applicationDescription: Underground municipal stormwater drainage, electrical cable vaults, sanitary sewer chambers, and telecom duct banks.
benefits: Zero plywood waste across 200+ pours
Collapsible corner keys for 15-minute striking
Hydrostatic concrete pressure capacity up to 60 kN/m²
Bespoke dimensions matching MOMRA & NWC specs

name: Circular Column Systems
tagline: Precision Rolled Steel Halves for Flawless Fair-Faced Geometry
shortDescription: Precision rolled two-half steel shuttering systems manufactured in Saudi Arabia for casting smooth, fair-faced circular columns.
description: Heavy cylindrical steel shells with integrated perimeter connection flanges and alignment wedges, handling rapid vertical concrete placement.
systemInformation: Two pre-curved steel half-shells bolt or wedge together securely. Concrete is placed in a single continuous lift, producing uniform fair-faced results without tie holes across the face.
applicationDescription: Commercial tower entrance columns, metro viaduct piers, high-ceiling architectural atriums, and infrastructure bridge supports.
benefits: Architectural Class A mirror-smooth concrete surface
No internal through-ties required across column diameter
Integrated pouring funnel and working platform brackets
Available in stock from Ø300mm to Ø2000mm

name: Precast Concrete Panel Moulds
tagline: Industrial Tilting Tables and Battery Moulds Built for Off-Site Speed
shortDescription: Factory-produced heavy industrial moulds and tilting beds engineered in KSA for repetitive precast concrete wall elements and boundary enclosures.
description: Machined steel casting beds with integrated magnetic side formers, heating pipe conduits, and hydraulic tilt mechanisms.
systemInformation: Rebar cages are placed onto the polished steel deck. Concrete is poured, vibrated via integral high-frequency vibrators, cured, and tilted up to 80° for safe crane demoulding.
applicationDescription: National border security walls, modular housing panels, warehouse tilt-up panels, and civil retaining walls.
benefits: Sub-millimeter flatness tolerances across 14-meter table lengths
Hydraulic tilting up to 80° preventing green-concrete cracking
Adaptable magnetic edge shutters for infinite panel widths
Fabricated with domestic high-grade steel

name: Grinder Steel Shutter
tagline: Heavy-Duty Structural Steel Shuttering for Massive Repetitive Casting
shortDescription: An extra-heavy duty fabricated steel shutter and formwork system engineered for non-deflecting repetitive casting in major Saudi civil works.
description: High-moment steel walers welded directly to 5mm faceplates with robust external taper-tie connection points.
systemInformation: Large modular crane-handled gangs are coupled together with high-shear pins. Concrete is placed in high-velocity lifts without risk of face bulge.
applicationDescription: Massive retaining walls, deep basement perimeters, strategic water storage reservoirs, and power plant substations.
benefits: Over 300 successful pour reuses with minimal maintenance
Eliminates surface plywood replacement costs
Engineered for 90 kN/m² hydrostatic concrete pressure
Complete local parts availability in Riyadh and Dammam

name: Bespoke Highway Pier Systems
tagline: Bespoke Heavy-Gauge Steel Shuttering for Bridges and Interchange Pylons
shortDescription: A customized structural steel shuttering system manufactured for casting reinforced-concrete bridge piers, viaduct columns, and flared hammerhead caps.
description: Multi-segment modular steel forms engineered to match project-specific geometric curvature and cross-sectional tapers.
systemInformation: Curved panels are rigged into place around heavy reinforcing cages. Anchor ties and integral working access brackets enable safe, monolithic casting in 4m to 8m vertical segments.
applicationDescription: High-speed rail viaducts, highway interchange flyovers, marine bridge pylons, and heavy infrastructure overpasses.
benefits: Engineered FEA stress analysis for severe desert wind gust dynamics
Full pre-assembly verification at Riyadh plant prior to dispatch
Self-supporting tie-free options for signature architectural bridge piers
Seamless compatibility with heavy shoring falsework

name: ULMA ORMA Modular Formwork
nameAr: نظام شدات أولما أورما المعيارية للحوائط
tagline: European Benchmark for High-Efficiency Concrete Wall & Column Construction
shortDescription: An engineered modular panel formwork system developed by ULMA in Spain, designed for rapid crane-handled forming of large concrete wall surfaces.
description: High-strength perimeter steel frame with reinforced corners enclosing 21mm Finnish birch phenolic plywood face, joined by a single-strike BFD clamp.
systemInformation: Panels join rapidly with the multi-function BFD clamp which aligns, stiffens, and tightly locks adjacent panels in a single motion, handling 80 kN/m² concrete pressure.
applicationDescription: High-rise building cores, shear walls, retaining structures, bridge abutments, and underground infrastructure.
benefits: Certified to EN 12812 European temporary works norms
Only 2 tie rods required for 3.3m high panels
BFD clamp achieves panel connection and flush alignment simultaneously
Extensive rental stock available across KSA

name: ULMA BRIO Ringlock Scaffolding
nameAr: نظام سقالات أولما بريو رينج لوك متعددة الاتجاهات
tagline: Gold Standard European Multidirectional Scaffolding for Access & Shoring
shortDescription: A certified multidirectional ringlock scaffolding system designed and certified according to European standards EN 12810-1/2 and EN 12811-1/2/3.
description: Standards equipped with patented 8-hole connection rosettes at 500mm spacing, accepting ledger and diagonal brace heads with captive wedge locks.
systemInformation: Ledger cast ends slide over the rosette disc. The integrated captive steel wedge is driven through the matching opening and secured with a single hammer blow.
applicationDescription: Architectural facades, petrochemical refineries, industrial boiler maintenance, complex curved structures, and public temporary pedestrian bridges.
benefits: Certified under AENOR Product Certification according to EN 12810/11
Supports up to 8 connections at a single node without geometric interference
High leg capacity up to 75 kN when configured as heavy shoring
Anti-tilt non-slip perforated steel decking

name: ULMA Heavy Shoring Systems (MK / T-500)
nameAr: أبراج التدعيم الثقيل أولما إم كيه و تي-500
tagline: Extreme-Capacity Structural Falsework Towers Supporting Up to 500 kN Per Leg
shortDescription: A high-load modular shoring and truss falsework system engineered for heavy civil concrete structures, viaduct spans, and deep transfer slabs.
description: Modular MK structural steel walers combined into independent towers, gantry falsework frames, or launching carriages.
systemInformation: MK walers bolt together via standardized high-tensile connection plates. Hydraulic jacks at base or head allow controlled pre-loading and millimeter-accurate post-pour release.
applicationDescription: Balanced cantilever bridges, post-tensioned flyover spans, mega-transfer beam supports, and tunnel portal casting.
benefits: Enormous load capacity from 250 kN up to 500 kN per shoring column
Allows large traffic clearance spans underneath without closing live roads
Complete structural calculation package signed by European and Saudi PEs
Fully compatible with ULMA formwork decks

name: Specialized Climbing & Hydraulic Systems (ATR)
nameAr: أنظمة الشدات المتخصصة والتسلق الهيدروليكي الآلي
tagline: Crane-Independent Hydraulic Self-Climbing Formwork for Mega-Tower Cores
shortDescription: Crane-free hydraulic climbing systems and rail-guided perimeter safety screens designed for ultra-tall skyscraper towers and suspension pylons.
description: Continuous mast rails anchored to cast concrete sleeves with synchronized hydraulic climbing cylinders moving multi-story platforms simultaneously.
systemInformation: Hydraulic power units advance the climbing rails upward into fresh anchor shoes, followed by the entire platform assembly in an automated cycle.
applicationDescription: Skyscrapers exceeding 40 floors, high-wind airport control towers, telecommunications obelisks, and deep dam pylons.
benefits: Operates independently of tower crane availability, saving critical crane time
Full weather and wind enclosure protecting crews up to extreme elevations
Heavy concrete placing boom can be mounted directly onto the climbing mast
Zero drop hazard with continuous mechanical pawl locking

name: Project-Specific Engineered Solutions
tagline: Turnkey Finite Element Analysis, BIM Coordination, and Custom Structural Weldments
shortDescription: A comprehensive temporary works engineering service integrating 3D BIM clash detection, structural static calculations, and hybrid European-Saudi equipment assemblies.
description: High-density structural calculations paired with custom fabricated transition brackets that bridge standard ULMA systems with site-specific architectural geometry.
systemInformation: Engineers analyze structural drawings, build parametric 3D models in Navisworks/Revit, run FEA load simulations, and fabricate custom connection nodes at our Riyadh center.
applicationDescription: Iconic cultural pavilions, stadium cantilevered canopies, tunnel carriage shuttering, and deep station cut-and-cover excavations.
benefits: Full compliance with Saudi Building Code (SBC) and European Eurocodes
Zero-clash digital twin submittals for tier-1 consultants
PE-stamped calculation books accepted across NEOM, Red Sea, and Qiddiya
On-site resident engineer supervision during erection

technicalFeatures.value: Autodesk Revit, Navisworks, RSTAB, Dlubal FEA

name: Working Platforms & Circular Access (SGF / KSP)
nameAr: منصات العمل المحيطية والوصول للمنشآت الدائرية
tagline: High-Security Perimeter Staging and Suspended Brackets for Silos and Storage Tanks
shortDescription: Modular perimeter brackets and suspended staging platforms designed to wrap circular storage tanks, flared bridge piers, and silo perimeters with zero fall hazard.
description: Heavy-duty cantilevered brackets anchoring directly into prior pour tie-rod cones with fully integrated perimeter mesh screens and toe boards.
systemInformation: Brackets hang from anchor cones placed in previous concrete lifts. Workers assemble safe continuous circular walkways that follow the structure radius smoothly.
applicationDescription: Wastewater clarifier tanks, cryogenic LNG spherical storage, grain silos, and stepped bridge pylon pours.
benefits: Completely enclosed work zones with fall arrest anchor rings
Adjustable bracket inclination compensates for batter angles up to 20°
Hot-dip galvanized components withstand harsh coastal and industrial environments
OSHA and Saudi Civil Defense safety compliance
